title: Yummy German Quinoa Wrap
description: Resinous, bouncy-qq, date-night German dish featuring pink food colouring, leaf-wrap-steam, gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until water runs clear.
Cook quinoa in a saucepan with 200 ml water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 12 minutes until fluffy.
Let quinoa cool to room temperature.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese over each spinach leaf.
Spread pink beet puree on top of the cream cheese.
Place a few pickled cucumber strips and mint leaves on the puree.
Drizzle a small amount of olive oil and sprinkle sea salt over the filling.
Wrap the spinach leaf tightly and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Serve immediately and enjoy the bouncy texture and German flair.
